summary: The guard Retention Anthology: Around and Under covers recovery against passes around and underneath the legs.
description: Lachlan Giles and Ariel Tabak’s course on retention against torreandos, leg drags, north-south movement and stacks.
overview: Lachlan Giles and Ariel Tabak’s Around and Under course focuses on keeping guard as the passer moves around or underneath the legs. General concepts and movements support sections on around-the-legs, north-south and under-the-legs retention. Specific passing situations and rolling breakdowns connect that material to live exchanges.

guide.display_title: Giles and Tabak: Guard Retention Around and Under

fits: You lose guard to torreandos, leg drags, movement toward north-south or under-the-legs passing.

includes: Retention concepts and movements, around-the-legs recovery and north-south situations.
Under-the-legs retention, stack-related problems, specific passes and rolling breakdowns.
limits: This release focuses on around- and under-the-legs passing rather than close-range passing through the legs.
